QuestInfo.name: Lumberless
QuestInfo.1: #bAyan#k believes the Tribal Refugee Camp is in \n#rdanger#k. She wants to erect wooden fences to fend off monsters, but she needs more #rwood#k. Bring back 20 #bCursed Planks#k from #rSinister Wooden Masks#k.

0.0: This place is so dangerous. We don't know when the #rnearby monsters#k will attack, so we're essentially living in fear.
0.1: I'd feel better if we at least had some wooden fences, but we don't have the hands or materials to build them. Can you help us? The #bCursed Planks#k, from nearby #rSinister Wooden Masks#k, should do the trick.

yes.0: Thank you. I won't ever forget what you've done for us. I think #b20 Cursed Planks#k should be enough to protect this place.

no.0: I'm not even surprised at this point. I'll just do what I can!

1.0: Did you gather the #b20 Cursed Planks#k to protect this place?

yes.0: Thank you. The people should be able to rest easier now.

item.0: Did you not gather all #b20 Cursed Planks#k? Please...
